gap_report_metadata.requirement_title: As a Foot Locker online customer, I want to navigate across primary categories, view brand & sale pages, interact with product grids and global footer links, So that I can easily discover products, view clear pricing, and access essential site information.

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: [AC-1] Homepage & Global Header Loading - The homepage (https://www.footlocker.com/) must load with the title containing "Foot Locker", page body rendered, global header visible, and primary navigation items present (Men's, Women's, Kids', Sale, Releases).
mapped_test_case_titles: TC-002: Global nav bar is visible

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: [AC-2] Primary Category Navigation - Clicking on Men's, Women's, or Kids' in the primary navigation bar must navigate the browser away from the homepage to their respective category landing pages.
[AC-3] Logo Navigation & Site Return - Clicking the Foot Locker logo from any page must navigate the user back to https://www.footlocker.com/.
mapped_test_case_titles: TC-009: Logo click returns to homepage

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: [AC-4] Cart Icon Navigation - Clicking the Cart icon in the header must navigate the user to the cart page (/cart).
mapped_test_case_titles: TC-010: Cart icon navigates to cart page

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: [AC-5] Primary Navigation Hover & Mega-Menu - Hovering over Men's in the primary navigation must open the mega-menu panel and display a Shoes sub-category link with a valid href.
mapped_test_case_titles: TC-008: Mega-menu sub-links render for Men's

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: [AC-6] Primary Navigation Direct Links (Releases & Sale) - Clicking Releases must navigate to /release-calendar and display the Release Calendar. Clicking Sale must navigate to /category/sale.html and display sale content.
[AC-7] Category Navigation Status - Direct navigation to main primary categories (Men's, Women's, Kids', Sale, Releases) must return a successful (non-error) response status.
mapped_test_case_titles: TC-011: No broken links across primary nav

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: [AC-8] Category Page Results & Product Tile Pricing - Navigating to a category page (e.g., /category/mens/shoes.html) must display a results-count heading matching "Showing {N} results". The product grid must contain visible product tiles displaying non-empty titles and prices formatted as $X.XX.
mapped_test_case_titles: TC-012: Product grid renders on category page
TC-013: Product tile shows name and valid price

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: [AC-9] Sale Page Dual Pricing - Locating product tiles on the Sale page must display two price values (an original price and a discounted price).
mapped_test_case_titles: TC-014: Sale page shows discounted pricing

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: [AC-10] Hero / Promo Banner Verification - The homepage hero/promo banner heading must be visible with non-empty text and include a call-to-action link with a valid href.
mapped_test_case_titles: TC-015: Homepage hero banner has content and CTA

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: [AC-11] Brand Page Display & Product Links - Navigating to a dedicated brand page (e.g., /category/brands/nike.html) must load the brand page, display brand-related text, and contain at least one related product link.
mapped_test_case_titles: TC-016: Brand page shows brand-specific content (Nike)

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: [AC-12] Header Store Locator & Footer Verification - "Find a Store" must be visible in the header. The footer must be visible upon scrolling, contain at least one link, and include a Privacy-related link with a valid href.
